extraction.notes: Whole amending law read (Official Gazette 132/25, three pages). No item extracted: no in-scope content. The law amends the Law on Employment and Insurance in Case of Unemployment, which is general labour-market legislation, and nothing in this text links it to EU or foreign workers, EURES, social security coordination or EHIC. Its provisions rename the ministry responsible for labour, the Ministry of Information Society and Administration (now Ministry of Public Administration, Arts 3 and 8, an incidental renaming) and the State Commission for second-instance decisions (Arts 5 to 7); delete two words in Art. 3-б (Art. 1); and in Art. 10 change a certificate requirement in Art. 91(4) point 5, removing a five-year age limit and adding a certificate of level B2 in English, French or German. The text does not say whom Art. 91 applies to, and the base law is not among the registered sources, so no connection to Chapter 2 is inferred. Being registered against Chapter 2 is not enough (extraction rules, section 4). Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2).
